scope: Re-review of v2 against the unchanged original source collection, Paperclip identity boundary, architecture advice and TC risk evidence. This is not product/test approval. No code, tests, dependencies, DB, or services were changed or run.

v1_findings.evidence: Job.workflow_version now derives only from verified snapshot.payload.workflow.workflow_id, with registry ID ifpmic-sw-v1; schema_version remains format version and source/state/agent/bundle SHA pins remain separate.

The plan pins catalog fields and uniqueness/FKs, append-only eligibility and revocation records, eligibility conditions, separate operator DB role, import-profile and mock-only grant/revoke commands, fail-closed absence of real-grant issuance, and synthetic DB fixtures as non-approval evidence.

Every semantic CreateJob field is stored as ensure_ascii/sorted/compact ASCII JSON TEXT command_payload_json; it is consumed after restart, with a fixed semantic body-digest formula and restart oracle.

Free text labels are retained losslessly through ASCII-escaped JSON TEXT; project_id is explicitly Unicode scalar and artifact IDs are server identifiers; behavior is non-normalizing and restart-testable.

CSRF derivation is fixed as domain-separated HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical session cookie, stable across session GET/restart, with a private provisioned key, no DB persistence of the CSRF token, and rotation bound to session rotation. G3 adds the stable/restart test.

coverage_review.original_b02_scope: PASS. Retains user-scoped FastAPI API, PostgreSQL request storage and per-request workspace; preserves the original API schema and approved source architecture, keeps AX localhost/read-only, and keeps Paperclip as management/UI rather than identity authority.
coverage_review.authorization_and_at21: PASS WITH EXPLICIT PARTIAL-ACCEPTANCE BOUNDARY. The plan retains authenticated owner assignment, active project membership, explicit job delegation, repository-scoped checks, and AT-21 negative isolation across job/log/image/device. It expressly does not claim AT-21 complete from synthetic or missing routes; real independent-user integration remains pending B04/B09.
coverage_review.bridge_unicode_bytes: PASS. Fixed private Node bridge delegates validation to B01 and stores verified raw canonical bytes as BYTEA; label strings use lossless escaped text; limits, framing, hashes, identity checks and privacy are testable.
coverage_review.atomicity_and_workspace: PASS. DRAFT plus accepted command, outbox, snapshot binding and RESERVED workspace intent are one commit; receipt follows commit and uncertain-commit retry is specified. Workspace state, marker publication, fsync, claim fencing, restart and failure behavior are explicit and leave workflow transitions to B03 Temporal.
coverage_review.phases_agents_oracles_recovery: PASS. G0-G7 specify purpose, method/agent, pass criteria, evidence and failure recovery. Real PostgreSQL, protocol fixture and actual temporary filesystem/process tests are required; mock-only database acceptance is excluded.
coverage_review.regression_gate: PASS. The Node full-gate timeout is raised to a fixed 180s with rationale, while per-test and Python integration deadlines remain bounded. UI/browser gate omission is conditional on exact unchanged source/dependency/output comparison against accepted controls and no frontend connection; semantic change expands or restores the gate.
coverage_review.dependency_and_authlib_gate: PASS AS A GATE, NOT AS VERIFIED COMPATIBILITY. Exact package candidates are pinned; install, resolution, hash locking and API compatibility are explicit G1 preconditions, and unexpected version conflicts require plan revision. No claim of installed or working Authlib integration is made.

blocking_findings.title: OIDC callback authorization code/state are not protected from request/access logs
blocking_findings.evidence: The plan adds GET /auth/callback carrying OAuth code and state in its query. It prohibits OAuth/ID/access tokens and session tokens in logs, but does not include authorization code, state, nonce, callback query strings, or request-line access logging in that prohibition. The selected Uvicorn deployment can have access logging; a default request-line logger may record the callback query. The G3 privacy criteria cover provider secrets and sanitized transcripts but do not explicitly test that logs contain no callback code/state.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Specify that all callback credentials (authorization code, state and any token-bearing query values) and session/CSRF values are redacted from access/application/error logs, or disable query-bearing access logging for these routes. Add a fixed synthetic canary test that exercises callback success/failure and scans captured logs to prove the canary values are absent. Do not publish the canary values.

nonblocking_observations: Eligibility is now implementable for mock catalog fixtures and fail-closed for real profiles without approved authority. Real eligibility issuance remains explicitly outside this local candidate, which is correctly described as an environment acceptance prerequisite.
Authlib/FastAPI and HTTP client API compatibility remains unverified until G1 by design; plan requires an isolated pinned environment and no silent dependency substitution.
reviewer_verdict: Do not begin implementation against this exact SHA yet. V2 resolves all five v1 findings and otherwise provides a testable full-scope B02 plan, but revise the auth logging/privacy contract and its G3 canary oracle, then request an exact-SHA review.
